title: Voiced, captioned short
summary: Turn footage and a script into a finished short: narration, timed captions, music under the voice, and a loudness and caption check before export.
author: Viral Hit contributors

inputs.label: Script or goal
inputs.description: The line-by-line script, or the message and length to write one for.

inputs.label: Footage
inputs.description: Clips or generated shots already in the project.

stages.title: Script
stages.description: Write or confirm a script that fits the footage length.

stages.title: Voice
stages.description: Generate narration and check it against the script.

stages.title: Captions and mix
stages.description: Time captions to the voice, duck music, check loudness.

stages.title: Export
stages.description: Render and review the full result.
